# The Researcher's Workspace (master plan, section 18, stage 2). The page talks
# to the server at api.populiverse.com (folder server/ of the repository).
# Signed out it shows the three doors; signed in it shows the shelf. On the
# editor's Mac the preview shows the pages, and says that sign-in works on
# populiverse.com. No title above the tabs (the row of 2026-11-13 on the
# mockup, point 6).
# For the opening this front door is open to search engines: it has a
# description, no noindex, and it stands in the sitemap. The other seven pages
# of the Workspace show nothing without a sign-in, so they stay hidden (the
# wrap-up before the opening, Part D).
resources:
  - workspace.js
  - write.js
